description: This file defines the PlatformBookingsService class, which manages platform booking operations such as retrieving attendee emails and OAuth client parameters based on event types.

classes.name: PlatformBookingsService
classes.description: Service class for handling platform booking related operations, including attendee email retrieval and OAuth client parameter fetching.

methods.name: getPlatformAttendeesEmails
methods.description: Retrieves emails of platform attendees by their guest emails and platform client ID.

methods.name: getPlatformAttendeeEmail
methods.description: Determines the correct attendee email, considering OAuth client ID inclusion.

methods.name: getOAuthClientParams
methods.description: Fetches OAuth client parameters based on an event type ID.

methods.name: getOAuthClientParamsForEventType
methods.description: Fetches OAuth client parameters based on an event type object with userId and teamId.
